description: This file contains utility functions and request handling logic for making API calls using axios, including URL building, headers, request body, error handling, and request execution.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a string.

methods.name: isStringWithValue
methods.description: Checks if a value is a non-empty string.

methods.name: isBlob
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a Blob.

methods.name: isFormData
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is FormData.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Checks if an HTTP status code indicates success (200-299).

methods.name: base64
methods.description: Encodes a string to base64, using btoa or Buffer depending on environment.

methods.name: getQueryString
methods.description: Builds a URL query string from an object of parameters.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Constructs a full URL based on OpenAPI config and request options.

methods.name: getFormData
methods.description: Creates FormData from request options if formData is provided.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a value or a promise, used for async configuration.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Generates request headers, including authorization and content-type.

methods.name: getRequestBody
methods.description: Returns the request body if present.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request using axios with proper configuration and cancellation support.

methods.name: getResponseHeader
methods.description: Extracts a specific header value from an axios response.

methods.name: getResponseBody
methods.description: Extracts the response data, handling 204 No Content.

methods.name: catchErrorCodes
methods.description: Handles HTTP error codes, throwing ApiError with appropriate messages.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Main function to perform an API request, returning a CancelablePromise.
